content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (spherical nesting benchmark postprocessing) overlaying eta snapshots from a coarse outer run (Grid A, fdir1='/Users/fengyanshi/tmp2/', dx1=4) and a nested fine run (Grid B, fdir2='/Users/fengyanshi/tmp4/', dx2=2) at times t=100/200/300/400 s (snapshot names eta_0100..eta_0400). Axes ax=[1000 5500 -0.02 0.15] (L8); grid-B x-coordinates shifted by shift=2004 (L17, L31) so the two grids align; a red vertical line at x=2000 marks the nesting boundary (L26, L38, annotated 'nesting'/'boundary' L27-28). Subplot 211 shows Grid A profiles, 212 shows Grid B with per-snapshot time labels t=100s..t=400s at x=2050..5050 (L39-42). Snapshots 0200/0300/0400 are appended to both axes (L44-73). No writes.
entities: script variables: fdir1 @L2, fdir2 @L3, dx1 @L5, dx2 @L6, ax @L8, num @L10/L44/L55/L65, z1 @L11, z2 @L12, x1 @L14, x2 @L15, shift @L17

equations.ref: grid A axis (x2 with dx2 L15)
grid B shifted to global frame (also L52, L62, L72)

unresolved: shift=2004 (L17) offsets Grid B by 2004 m while the nesting boundary line is drawn at 2000 (L26, L38) -- the 4 m difference (one coarse cell) is unexplained in the file.

Snapshot names eta_0100..0400 with time labels 100-400 s imply 1-s snapshot numbering; dx1/dx2 in meters and the 1D profile assumption (z loaded as vector) depend on the run configuration, external to this file.
fdir1/fdir2 are hard-coded personal paths; unterminated statements at L8 and L10/L44/L55/L65 echo to console.
